messages:
incident-bot: :warning: New incident: elevated 5xx on api.prod detected by SLO monitors at 09:13 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/api-errors

eng-oncall: getting the page. dashboards look funky though — a lot of Datadog panels show gaps since ~09:10 UTC. Not seeing request latency series for several hosts.

Priya G.: yep, Datadog metrics/logs are delayed. Agent health checks show normal push rates from the hosts. Suspect Datadog ingestion delays/backlog.

Alex H.: ran a quick curl against status.datadoghq.com -> slow and intermittent. `curl -s https://status.datadoghq.com/` returned 502 for me.

Liam (Platform): customers seeing errors? Our internal request counters (kafka metrics) show some error spike on payments shard. We need a mitigation plan for observability blind spot so we don't get blind to customer impact.

Marta (SRE): suggested mitigations: (1) switch critical alerts to internal metrics pipeline (kafka -> Prometheus -> Grafana), (2) start granular log export to S3 for a 1h window, (3) temporarily reduce nonessential traffic (analytics/batch), (4) enable aggressive agent-side retry/backoff for datadog endpoint.

eng-oncall: taking lead. Priya, can you open a Datadog case and paste it here? Also add a link to their incident if available. Paging PD for escalation.

Priya G.: opened case 5512003 with Datadog. Auto-reply: "Customers in us-east-1 may experience ingestion delays due to backlog; our team is working on backfill. Expected resolution in 30-60 minutes." Case link: https://support.datadoghq.com/cases/5512003

incident-bot: PagerDuty: On-call Josh R. has been paged and acknowledged at 09:19 UTC.

Alex H.: immediate actions I ran:
```
# bring up local aggregator
sudo systemctl enable --now metrics-aggregator
# push a few sanity metrics to CloudWatch
aws cloudwatch put-metric-data --namespace Redwood/Internal --metric-name api.requests.p90 --value 250 --region us-east-1
```
Also kicking a deployment for agent-forwarder with improved retry logic. Rolling to 20% of hosts.

Liam (Platform): I've created a temporary Grafana dashboard that reads from Prometheus + CloudWatch: https://grafana.internal/d/incident/api-1998765432. Use that for triage.

eng-oncall: patching alert rules to prevent noisy DD-derived alerts. New rule points to internal-kafka-metrics for the incident window.

Marta (SRE): starting throttles for background jobs: analytics-ingest and external-sync. Commands applied to k8s jobs. That should reduce noise while backfill occurs.

Priya G.: Datadog updated case 5512003: "We are ingesting backlog; metrics and logs will be backfilled gradually. Next update in 20m."

Sam (Support) (via DM to eng-oncall): customers reporting missing datapoints in their dashboards. Preparing a short status blurb for customers.

eng-oncall: customer note draft: "We're investigating an observability provider outage impacting visibility into metrics/logs for some regions. We are actively using internal telemetry and fallbacks to assess service impact. We'll follow up as we learn more." Share for review.

Marta (SRE): include mitigation summary and affected tenants list. From internal counters payments-1 and auth-2 saw higher 5xx rates (roughly 2.8x baseline) between 09:109:18 UTC; retries recovered many requests.

Priya G.: datadog support replied: "Backfill proceeding; no customer action required at this time. We'll post final update when backfill completes." ETA 45m.

eng-oncall: switched noisy alerts to silence and set TTL for 1h. Please monitor internal dashboards and escalate if errors persist.

Alex H.: added agent-forwarder retry logic snippet to the thread and kicked restart for daemonset: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/agent-forwarder -n infra` (30% rollout).

Liam (Platform): created an incident tag `dd-visibility-2026-03-15` and added initial timeline to the incident board.

Datadog Support: (case 5512003) "Backfill complete for the impacted metrics/logs in us-east-1. Please verify and re-open the case if you observe missing data."

Marta (SRE): I'm seeing Datadog panels repopulating and internal dashboards match. Closing active mitigation at 10:07 UTC. I'll own the post-incident review — opening PM-INC-2026-48 and assigning to SRE+Platform to evaluate a multi-observability fallback and runbook improvements.

Priya G.: added the datadog case id and timeline to the ticket. Also attached the internal query results for payments-1.

eng-oncall: incident closed at 10:07 UTC. Notes: implement automatic CloudWatch fallback in the runbook, ensure S3 log export is an explicit step, evaluate alerting to reduce dependency on a single provider. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
